_note: 市场连接器=远程 MCP 端点配置，无内容包。凭据位保留空串或 <REDACTED>，需使用者自行填入自己的 token/OAuth 客户端。
_source: Qoder apphub 详情端点 /connectors/<id>（leader 侧带鉴权抓取，本脚本只读已落盘快照）
description: Manage Neon serverless Postgres databases, branches, and projects
description_cn: 管理 Neon Serverless Postgres 数据库、分支和项目

tools.description: Lists the organizations the user belongs to; an organization API key gets its own organization. search filters by name or id.
tools.name: list_organizations

tools.description: Runs one SQL statement on a branch's database and returns its rows. After a prepare step, pass its temporary branch_id. NEVER run destructive SQL autonomously; always ask the user first.
tools.name: run_sql

tools.description: Runs several SQL statements in one transaction and returns each one's rows. After a prepare step, pass its temporary branch_id. NEVER run destructive SQL autonomously; always ask the user first.
tools.name: run_sql_transaction

tools.description: Returns a table's columns, indexes, constraints, and sizes. For every table, use get_database_tables.
tools.name: describe_table_schema

tools.description: Lists a database's tables and views outside the system schemas. For one table's columns, use describe_table_schema.
tools.name: get_database_tables

tools.description: Applies a schema change on a new temporary branch and returns a migration_id. Test it there with run_sql, ask the user, then always call complete_database_migration with the response's complete object so the branch is deleted.
tools.name: prepare_database_migration

tools.description: Applies or discards a prepared migration and deletes the temporary branch. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. Pass the complete object from prepare_database_migration; apply_changes false discards.
tools.name: complete_database_migration

tools.description: Returns a branch summary, its database names, and a tree of one database's schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, and functions. Starts a suspended compute. Branch record only: get_branch; table names: get_database_tables; columns: describe_table_schema.
tools.name: describe_branch

tools.description: Returns a Postgres connection string with a role password; the branch needs a compute. Omitted inputs resolve like the SQL tools: default branch, neondb or the first database, and its owner. Call it after create_project or create_branch, which return none. `project_id` follows the connection scope. Requires write access: the connection string carries a privileged role password, so it is unavailable in read-only mode. A read-only caller who needs a DATABASE_URL must copy it from [REDACTED] manually.
tools.name: get_connection_string

tools.description: Returns a branch's Neon Auth integration and settings: trusted origins, localhost, email and password, OAuth and email providers, plugins, webhook, and logs export, with secrets redacted. Needs Neon Auth on the branch (provision_neon_auth).
tools.name: get_neon_auth_config

tools.description: Returns a statement's execution plan as JSON. analyze true executes it, side effects included, so never analyze potentially destructive SQL autonomously. For rows, use run_sql.
tools.name: explain_sql_statement

tools.description: Runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE for a slow query on a new temporary branch; returns the plan, table schemas, and a tuning_id. Try changes there with run_sql and explain_sql_statement, then always call complete_query_tuning with the complete object so the branch is deleted. Not prepare_database_migration.
tools.name: prepare_query_tuning

tools.description: Applies or discards query-tuning changes and deletes the temporary branch. NEVER run autonomously. Pass the complete object from prepare_query_tuning and suggested_sql_statements; apply_changes true applies, omitted discards. Call it even when the user rejects.
tools.name: complete_query_tuning

tools.description: Lists queries from pg_stat_statements, slowest mean execution time first. For sizes, indexes, locks, cache, bloat, or replication, use inspect_database.
tools.name: list_slow_queries

tools.description: Runs one read-only neon inspect db check; some are compute-wide. outliers ranks queries by total time and calls by count, both via pg_stat_statements; lfc-hit-rate and working-set need the neon extension. If one is missing, the error gives the CREATE EXTENSION; ask before running it. Other SQL: run_sql; one plan: explain_sql_statement; new indexes: prepare_query_tuning.
tools.name: inspect_database

tools.description: Finds organizations, projects (including shared ones), branches, computes, and snapshots whose name or id contains query, with ids for fetch. To list projects, use list_projects; for docs, search_docs.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Returns an organization, project, branch, compute, or snapshot by an id from search: markdown text, console URL, and records in metadata.
tools.name: fetch

tools.description: Searches neon.com docs, API reference, PostgreSQL tutorial, guides, FAQs, changelog, and blog for ranked pages with the slug get_doc reads.
tools.name: search_docs

tools.description: Returns one neon.com page as markdown, by the slug of a search_docs hit.
tools.name: get_doc

tools.description: Sends anonymous feedback text to the Neon team, with no account, project, or connection details. Only call it when the user asks to give feedback.
tools.name: send_feedback

tools.description: Lists open Neon incidents and maintenance from neonstatus.com and the affected components and regions. Needs no credentials. Call it when Neon requests fail unexpectedly or the user asks whether Neon is down.
tools.name: list_incidents

tools.description: Lists the projects in an organization; search filters by name or id. To also find branches, computes, or snapshots, use search. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many. `org_id` is optional: organization API keys use their organization; personal API keys auto-select when unambiguous and otherwise return the IDs to choose from.
tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: Counts an organization's active projects without listing them; ones being created or deleted are not counted. `org_id` is optional: organization API keys use their organization; personal API keys auto-select when unambiguous and otherwise return the IDs to choose from.
tools.name: count_projects

tools.description: Gets a project's settings, owner, and usage. For branches, use list_branches.
tools.name: describe_project

tools.description: Creates a project with a default branch and read-write compute and waits until it is ready. Returns no connection string; use get_connection_string. `org_id` is optional: organization API keys use their organization; personal API keys auto-select when unambiguous and otherwise return the IDs to choose from.
tools.name: create_project

tools.description: Updates a project's name, settings, default compute settings, or history retention.
tools.name: update_project

tools.description: Deletes a project with all its branches, computes, databases, and roles. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. recover_project undoes it within 7 days. For one branch, use delete_branch.
tools.name: delete_project

tools.description: Recovers a project deleted in the last 7 days; list_projects with recoverable true finds them. Some integrations need setting up again.
tools.name: recover_project

tools.description: Lists organization members and their roles on an [REDACTED] project; 404 when the project is not [REDACTED] or per-project roles are off. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: list_project_members

tools.description: Lists the regions you can create projects in. An organization API key gets 404.
tools.name: list_regions

tools.description: Lists a project's operations; ones older than six months may be gone. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: list_operations

tools.description: Gets one operation and its status.
tools.name: get_operation

tools.description: Returns per-project consumption in an organization. metrics: every name get_branch_consumption takes, plus extra_branches_month and snapshot_storage_bytes_month. Launch, Scale, Agent, Business, or Enterprise plans; others get 403. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: get_project_consumption

tools.description: Returns per-branch consumption for project_ids. metrics: compute_unit_seconds, root_branch_bytes_month, child_branch_bytes_month, instant_restore_bytes_month, public_network_transfer_bytes, private_network_transfer_bytes, functions_active_capacity_microseconds, functions_waiting_capacity_microseconds, functions_invocations, functions_egress_bytes. Usage-based Launch, Scale, Agent, or Enterprise plans only. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: get_branch_consumption

tools.description: Lists a project's branches with id (br-...), name, parent, and default flag; search finds a branch's id by name. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: list_branches

tools.description: Gets a branch record: name, parent, state, protection, size, and timestamps. For its databases and tables, use describe_branch.
tools.name: get_branch

tools.description: Creates a branch from its parent's current data, with a read-write compute unless no_compute, and waits until it is ready. Returns no connection string; use get_connection_string.
tools.name: create_branch

tools.description: Renames a branch, protects or unprotects it, or sets when it expires.
tools.name: update_branch

tools.description: Deletes a branch with all its data and disconnects its clients. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. The root, the default, and a branch with children cannot be deleted. For the whole project, use delete_project.
tools.name: delete_branch

tools.description: Gets the project's default branch by its default flag, not its name.
tools.name: get_default_branch

tools.description: Makes a branch the project's default; the previous default loses the flag.
tools.name: set_default_branch

tools.description: Resets a branch to its parent's current state, discarding the branch's own changes. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. preserve_under_name first saves the current state as a new branch. To restore a snapshot, use restore_snapshot.
tools.name: reset_from_parent

tools.description: Diffs one database's SQL schema on a branch against another branch, by default its parent. lsn, timestamp, base_lsn, and base_timestamp are only for point-in-time comparisons.
tools.name: compare_database_schema

tools.description: Finalizes a branch restored with finalize false: moves the original branch's computes onto it, restarting them, and takes over its name.
tools.name: finalize_branch_restore

tools.description: Lists a branch's Postgres roles.
tools.name: list_postgres_roles

tools.description: Gets a Postgres role on a branch.
tools.name: get_postgres_role

tools.description: Creates a Postgres role on a branch and returns its password. The default access, admin, joins neon_superuser: every database, creating databases and roles, bypassing row-level security, and it cannot be narrowed later. For least privilege pass read_only or read_write with database_name and schemas, covering the tables the database owner owns, now and later.
tools.name: create_postgres_role

tools.description: Deletes a Postgres role from a branch.
tools.name: delete_postgres_role

tools.description: Sets a new random password for a Postgres role and returns it. Drops the compute's connections.
tools.name: reset_postgres_role_password

tools.description: Lists a branch's databases and their owners.
tools.name: list_postgres_databases

tools.description: Gets a database on a branch and its owner.
tools.name: get_postgres_database

tools.description: Creates a database on a branch, owned by owner_name.
tools.name: create_postgres_database

tools.description: Renames a database or changes its owner.
tools.name: update_postgres_database

tools.description: Deletes a database and its data from a branch.
tools.name: delete_postgres_database

tools.description: Lists the compute endpoints of every branch in a project. For one branch, use list_branch_computes.
tools.name: list_postgres_endpoints

tools.description: Lists a branch's compute endpoints. For every branch in the project, use list_postgres_endpoints.
tools.name: list_branch_computes

tools.description: Gets a compute endpoint (ep-...), including its host and state.
tools.name: get_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Creates a compute endpoint on a branch; a branch takes one read-write endpoint and any number of read-only. Returns no connection string; use get_connection_string.
tools.name: create_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Updates a compute endpoint's settings.
tools.name: update_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Deletes a compute endpoint and drops its connections.
tools.name: delete_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Starts a suspended compute endpoint.
tools.name: start_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Suspends a compute endpoint, dropping its connections.
tools.name: suspend_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Restarts a compute endpoint by suspending and starting it, dropping its connections.
tools.name: restart_postgres_endpoint

tools.description: Lists a project's snapshots.
tools.name: list_snapshots

tools.description: Gets a branch's automatic snapshot schedule.
tools.name: get_snapshot_schedule

tools.description: Replaces a branch's automatic snapshot schedule.
tools.name: set_snapshot_schedule

tools.description: Creates a snapshot of a branch.
tools.name: create_snapshot

tools.description: Renames a snapshot or changes when it expires.
tools.name: update_snapshot

tools.description: Deletes a snapshot.
tools.name: delete_snapshot

tools.description: Restores a snapshot onto a new branch or onto target_branch_id and waits until it is ready. With finalize false, swap it in later with finalize_branch_restore.
tools.name: restore_snapshot

tools.description: Gets a branch's Neon Auth integration record: provider, base URL, JWKS URL, and database. Prefer get_neon_auth_config, which adds the auth settings, unless you only need the record.
tools.name: get_auth

tools.description: Enables Neon Auth on a branch and creates the neon_auth schema in its database.
tools.name: provision_neon_auth

tools.description: Disables Neon Auth on a branch. delete_data also drops the neon_auth schema and its tables.
tools.name: disable_auth

tools.description: Sets the application name Neon Auth uses in its emails.
tools.name: update_auth_config

tools.description: Lists the social login providers (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel, Apple, Discord) of a branch's Neon Auth. For Neon Auth as an OAuth server, use get_auth_oauth_server.
tools.name: list_auth_oauth_providers

tools.description: Adds a social login provider (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel, Apple, Discord) to a branch's Neon Auth. Microsoft, Apple, and Discord have no shared app, so they need your own `client_id` and `client_secret`. Apple and Discord work only on Better Auth projects, not legacy Stack Auth. For Apple, `client_id` is the Services ID, `client_secret` is the `.p8` private key, and `apple_team_id` and `apple_key_id` are required. For Neon Auth as an OAuth server, use update_auth_oauth_server.
tools.name: add_auth_oauth_provider

tools.description: Updates a social login provider (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel, Apple, Discord) on a branch's Neon Auth. For Apple, a new `client_secret` (`.p8` key) must be sent with its `apple_key_id`. For Neon Auth as an OAuth server, use update_auth_oauth_server.
tools.name: update_auth_oauth_provider

tools.description: Deletes a social login provider (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel, Apple, Discord) from a branch's Neon Auth. For Neon Auth as an OAuth server, use update_auth_oauth_server.
tools.name: delete_auth_oauth_provider

tools.description: Lists the domains a branch's Neon Auth may redirect to after sign-in.
tools.name: list_auth_trusted_domains

tools.description: Adds a domain a branch's Neon Auth may redirect to after sign-in.
tools.name: add_auth_trusted_domain

tools.description: Removes a domain from the ones a branch's Neon Auth may redirect to.
tools.name: delete_auth_trusted_domain

tools.description: Creates a Neon Auth user on a branch who can sign in right away.
tools.name: create_auth_user

tools.description: Deletes a Neon Auth user from a branch. Irreversible.
tools.name: delete_auth_user

tools.description: Sets the roles of a Neon Auth user on a branch.
tools.name: update_auth_user_role

tools.description: Gets a branch's Neon Auth OAuth 2.1 server settings (oauth_provider plugin), for example for MCP clients. For social login, use list_auth_oauth_providers.
tools.name: get_auth_oauth_server

tools.description: Configures a branch's Neon Auth as an OAuth 2.1 server (oauth_provider plugin); root branch only. Enabling needs login_page, consent_page, and a resource or MCP resource. resources replaces the stored list, so send the full list from get_auth_oauth_server.
tools.name: update_auth_oauth_server

tools.description: Lists the OAuth clients (apps, MCP clients) of a branch's Neon Auth OAuth server, without secrets; not social login providers.
tools.name: list_auth_oauth_clients

tools.description: Gets an OAuth client of a branch's Neon Auth OAuth server, without its secret.
tools.name: get_auth_oauth_client

tools.description: Registers an OAuth client with a branch's Neon Auth OAuth server. A confidential client's client_secret is returned once: show it to the user and tell them to store it. resources must already be on the server, or be its MCP resource (get_auth_oauth_server). type is permanent.
tools.name: create_auth_oauth_client

tools.description: Updates an OAuth client of Neon Auth's OAuth server; redirect_uris and resources replace the stored lists, and type cannot change.
tools.name: update_auth_oauth_client

tools.description: Deletes an OAuth client from Neon Auth's OAuth server, irreversibly; tokens already issued stay valid.
tools.name: delete_auth_oauth_client

tools.description: Issues a new secret for a confidential OAuth client; the old one stops working at once. The new client_secret is returned once: show it to the user and tell them to store it.
tools.name: rotate_auth_oauth_client_secret

tools.description: Sets whether a branch's Neon Auth accepts localhost origins; turn it off for production. Current value: get_neon_auth_config.
tools.name: update_auth_allow_localhost

tools.description: Updates a branch's Neon Auth email and password sign-in; omitted fields keep their value. Current values: get_neon_auth_config.
tools.name: update_auth_email_and_password

tools.description: Sets the email provider for Neon Auth's emails: body.type "shared" for Neon's sender, or "standard" with your SMTP details. Test it with send_auth_test_email.
tools.name: update_auth_email_provider

tools.description: Sends a test email through the branch's saved standard SMTP provider to recipient_email. Only send to an address the user gave you. A failed send returns success false with error_message, not an error.
tools.name: send_auth_test_email

tools.description: Updates the Neon Auth magic link plugin; omitted fields keep their value. Current values: get_neon_auth_config.
tools.name: update_auth_plugins_magic_link

tools.description: Updates the Neon Auth organization plugin, which lets your app's users form organizations (not Neon organizations). Omitted fields keep their value. Current values: get_neon_auth_config.
tools.name: update_auth_plugins_organization

tools.description: Updates the Neon Auth SMS OTP plugin; omitted fields keep their value. SMS needs a webhook with the send.otp event (update_auth_webhooks). Current values: get_neon_auth_config.
tools.name: update_auth_plugins_phone_number

tools.description: Replaces a branch's Neon Auth webhook configuration; omitted fields reset, so { enabled: false } alone clears webhook_url and enabled_events. Send every field to keep, read from get_neon_auth_config.
tools.name: update_auth_webhooks

tools.description: Turns the export of a branch's Neon Auth events to Neon Platform logs on or off. A project without logs export accepts only enabled: false; enabling there returns 404 feature not available. get_neon_auth_config reports the current value as logs_export, or null where logs export is not available.
tools.name: update_auth_logs_export

tools.description: Gets the Neon Data API configuration for one database on a branch.
tools.name: get_data_api

tools.description: Creates the Neon Data API, a REST interface over database_name, on a branch.
tools.name: provision_neon_data_api

tools.description: Updates the Neon Data API settings for a database and refreshes its schema cache.
tools.name: update_data_api

tools.description: Deletes the Neon Data API for a database; requests to its endpoint start failing.
tools.name: delete_data_api

tools.description: Returns a branch's log records. Filters combine with AND; pass logql or structured filters, not both. Pass since or start_time, not both; default last hour, max seven days. Private beta: a branch without logs returns 404 telemetry_not_enabled. Stream labels: query_loki_logs. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: query_logs

tools.description: Lists the low-cardinality log fields seen on a branch, for list_log_field_values.
tools.name: list_log_fields

tools.description: Lists the distinct values of one log field; a field the branch never emitted returns unknown_field. Pass since or start_time, not both; default last six hours, max seven days.
tools.name: list_log_field_values

tools.description: Runs a LogQL range query on a branch's logs and returns Loki's response: data.result groups lines by stream label as [nanosecond timestamp, line]. query_logs has structured filters; list_log_fields and list_log_field_values list labels. No cursor: limit lines, or the silent 10,000 cap, may mean more exist; narrow the window.
tools.name: query_loki_logs

tools.description: Gets a branch's AI Gateway host; a 404 says why it is unavailable.
tools.name: get_ai_gateway

tools.description: Lists the functions on a branch. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: list_functions

tools.description: Gets a function on a branch by slug.
tools.name: get_function

tools.description: Sets a function's display name; null resets it to the slug. Only the branch that owns the function can rename it.
tools.name: update_function

tools.description: Deletes a function from a branch.
tools.name: delete_function

tools.description: Deploys a function version from any of zip, environment, and runtime; omitted ones keep the latest value, and the first deployment needs zip. It can return while still pending.
tools.name: deploy_function

tools.description: Lists a branch's custom domains and their targets. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: list_functions_custom_domains

tools.description: Routes a domain you own to a function: entity_type function, entity_id the slug from list_functions. It goes live once a CNAME to the returned cname_target resolves.
tools.name: register_functions_custom_domain

tools.description: Removes a custom domain from a branch and stops routing it.
tools.name: delete_functions_custom_domain

tools.description: Lists a branch's function triggers, including inherited ones, which stay disabled on this branch until enabled.
tools.name: list_triggers

tools.description: Gets a function trigger on a branch.
tools.name: get_trigger

tools.description: Creates a trigger that calls a function on a five-field UTC cron schedule, or after an upload to one bucket, optionally under a key prefix. Names are unique on the branch.
tools.name: create_trigger

tools.description: Updates a function trigger; body.type must match its kind. Editing an inherited trigger makes a local copy, disabled unless this request enables it.
tools.name: update_trigger

tools.description: Deletes a function trigger, or hides an inherited one on this branch. Invocations already queued still run.
tools.name: delete_trigger

tools.description: Lists the scoped credentials issued on a branch, without secrets.
tools.name: list_credentials

tools.description: Issues a scoped credential on a branch. api_token and s3_secret_access_key are returned once: show them to the user and tell them to store them.
tools.name: create_credential

tools.description: Revokes a scoped credential. Idempotent.
tools.name: revoke_credential

tools.description: Replaces a scoped credential's secrets in place and returns them once; token_id stays. Not idempotent: if the response is lost, create a new credential (create_credential) and revoke this one instead of retrying.
tools.name: rotate_credential

tools.description: Checks whether object storage is available on a branch; a 404 says why not.
tools.name: get_storage

tools.description: Lists a branch's object storage buckets, inherited ones included.
tools.name: list_storage_buckets

tools.description: Creates an object storage bucket on a branch.
tools.name: create_storage_bucket

tools.description: Deletes a bucket from a branch.
tools.name: delete_storage_bucket

tools.description: Lists a bucket's objects on a branch, inherited ones included. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.
tools.name: list_storage_objects

tools.description: Deletes one object from a bucket on a branch.
tools.name: delete_storage_object

tools.description: Soft-deletes every object on this branch whose key starts with prefix and returns the count; inherited objects stay.
tools.name: delete_storage_objects_by_prefix

tools.description: Returns a short-lived presigned PUT or GET URL for one object, with the headers to send; no S3 credentials needed.
tools.name: presign_storage_object

tools.description: Gets a branch's Realtime state, URL, and allowed origins; the secret comes from get_realtime_secret.
tools.name: get_realtime

tools.description: Enables Realtime on a branch, or changes its allowed origins, and waits until it is applied.
tools.name: enable_realtime

tools.description: Disables Realtime on a branch, discarding its secret, and waits until it is applied.
tools.name: disable_realtime

tools.description: Gets the secret the application backend issues Realtime tokens with; 404 until enable_realtime has run. Requires write access: the secret lets its holder issue Realtime tokens for the branch, so it is unavailable in read-only mode.
tools.name: get_realtime_secret

tools.description: Replaces a branch's Realtime secret and waits until the old one stops working. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. Then update the application backend from get_realtime_secret.
tools.name: rotate_realtime_secret
